pr_title: Adds Warm Up Logic for Volatility Model with Options
pr_body:
#### Description
Adds warm-up logic for volatility model with options in `ConfigureUnderlyingSecurity` method.
Refactors `AddOptionContract` to use `ConfigureUnderlyingSecurity` so that this fix also covers the `OptionChainProvider` case.

#### Related Issue
Closes #4009 

#### Motivation and Context
Bug fix. When the algorithm is using the default volatility model, it should be ready to use (initialized).

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Regression test. A test for non-zero greek delta was added to the regression algorithm `OptionChainProviderAlgorithm`.

issue_context.title: Security Volatility Model Warm Up in Options Trading
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The greeks of options contracts have non-zero values in the first iteration.

#### Actual Behavior
The greeks of options contracts have zero values while the underlying volatility model is "cold".

#### Potential Solution
Warm-up the security volatility model when a correspondent Option object is created. 

#### Reproducing the Problem
Run `BasicTemplateOptionsHistoryAlgorithm` with more than 2 days period. It will show the greeks with zero values for the first 2 days of simulation since the default volatility model needs two inputs.
